summary: Warp Cores are Nomai technology that transport information, beings, and objects from one place to another (and, with the Advanced variant, into the past). Each consists of a paired black-hole core and white-hole core. The Advanced Warp Core inside Ash Twin is what powers the protagonist's 22-minute time loop.

behavior: A standard warp core consists of a black hole core and a white hole core which generate a black hole and white hole respectively.
Objects warped enter via the black hole and exit through the white hole.
If warp cores power a warp platform, travelers can also return through the white hole once the platform is charged.
The time of arrival is always one hundred-thousandth of a second earlier than the time of departure.
The negative time interval can be increased by adding more energy to the warp core.
The energy required to extend the negative interval increases at an exponential rate.
location: Warp Cores are manufactured at the Black Hole Forge in the Hanging City on Brittle Hollow.
Annona's broken advanced warp core sits inside The Vessel in Dark Bramble.
Poke's Advanced Warp Core powers the Ash Twin Project's central chamber on Ash Twin.
lore: Warp Cores were originally created by Annona, a Nomai from Escall's Vessel.
Annona shared his advanced warp core design with other Nomai clans at festivals, letting all Nomai warp long distances.
The Vessel's warp core needed time to recharge between significant jumps such as following the Eye's signal.
The Vessel's warp core sustained irreparable damage when the Vessel crashed on Dark Bramble.
After Annona's death on Ember Twin, Poke became his apprentice and learned many of his warp core designs.
Poke recreated Annona's simpler warp cores at the Black Hole Forge with the help of Clary and Root.
The Black Hole Forge crew's first successful warp connected the White Hole Station to Brittle Hollow's Northern Glacier.
Pye and Ramie confirmed the negative time interval by reproducing it at the High Energy Lab.
Pye, Ramie, and Poke hypothesized that advanced warp technology could extend the negative interval to 22 minutes.
The 22-minute negative interval became the foundation of the Ash Twin Project for sending information back in time.
Because the Vessel's warp core was unrecoverable, Poke crafted a new Advanced Warp Core inspired by Annona's design.
The Black Hole Forge crew also crafted simple warp cores for the Ash Twin Towers connecting Ash Twin to all Ash Twin Project locations.
The Ash Twin Project went on indefinite hold when the Sun Station failed to trigger a supernova.
All Nomai were killed by the Interloper's Ghost Matter before they could find an alternative power source.
200,000 years later, Hearthian astronauts discovered the Nomai's warp cores and adapted them.
Hearthians use recovered warp cores to power the Little Scout's warp-retrieval capability.
When the Sun reached its natural lifespan and went supernova, it automatically powered the Ash Twin Project's Advanced Warp Core, starting the time loop.
mechanics: Standard warp cores can only travel from a black hole to a white hole, so warping to an unfamiliar location requires placing a second warp core there first.
An Advanced Warp Core does not need a counterpart warp core to enable warping.
Advanced warp cores can open portals to specific coordinates, or with enough energy, open portals a certain amount of time into the past.
Simple warp cores power the Ash Twin Tower warp platforms, the White Hole Station warp tower, and its warp receivers on various planets.
Simple warp cores can recall shuttles launched from Gravity Cannons.
Simple warp cores can recall the Hearthians' Scout and Mica's remote-control model ship.
Advanced warp cores send information and commands 22 minutes into the past for the Ash Twin Project.
Advanced warp cores warp living beings and inanimate objects, including ships, over large distances.
